priorityRationale: Potential consequence of existing action interpretation first, then equation applicability and measurement dependencies; not empirical effect-size ranking. All claim families are assigned. Research value is independently sufficient.
reviewRecordRequired: search date, database, exact query, language/date limits and cutoff
primary source identifier, version, corrections/retractions and inaccessible portions
population, severity, treatment, intersections, method and time window
supporting and contrary results, endpoints and uncertainty
rights and inspected terms; pointer versus reusable content
claim/context disposition, reviewer, actual content-review date and next trigger

slices.title: Readiness and action boundaries
slices.reason: Current interface suggests session actions despite unvalidated thresholds.
slices.firstExecutableTask: Define precise propositions for sleep cutoffs, fatigue/pain handling, set bands and action wording; execute logged primary-study and authoritative-guidance searches; preserve no-evidence and out-of-scope findings.
slices.completion: Claim-level evidence dispositions, reproducible searches, source records, contradictions, explicit unreviewed limits and next-review triggers; no unsupported clinical promotion.

closure.scope: C08/C14/C15/C16/C31/C34/C35: targeted evidence relevance, contradictions and action boundaries. No new empirical Metron study; no complete clinical review.
closure.acceptanceReview: Reproducible targeted queries, primary/guidance records, support and contrary findings, claim-level dispositions, explicit clinical unknowns and review triggers are recorded. Whole H2 stays in progress.
